arguments:
set -Eeuo pipefail
export GIT_PAGER=cat PAGER=cat GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
tmp="$(mktemp -d /tmp/vps-coordinator-deps.XXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
git clone --quiet --depth 2 --branch main https://github.com/martaxi-boss/VPS.git "$tmp/repo"
cd "$tmp/repo"
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = 9fc305d4a813d0cc0f24434627fa4c31cd1773cf
python3 - <<'PY'
import ast,re,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
tracked=subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-files'],text=True).splitlines()
candidates=[p for p in tracked if p.startswith('ops/coordinator') or p.startswith('ops/chatgpt_coordinator') or p.startswith('ops/chatgpt_media') or p.startswith('ops/chatgpt_attachment') or p.startswith('ops/telegram_coordinator')]
candidates+=[p for p in tracked if p.startswith('ops/agent_switch') or p.startswith('ops/codex') and not ('quota' in p or 'resource' in p)]
for path in candidates:
 if not path.endswith('.py'): continue
 name=path[:-3].replace('/','.')
 users=[]
 for file in tracked:
  if not file.endswith('.py') or file==path:continue
  try: text=Path(file).read_text()
  except (UnicodeError,OSError):continue
  if name in text or name.rsplit('.',1)[-1] in text:
   users.append(file)
 print('MODULE_USES',path,','.join(users[:35]),flush=True)
for path in ('ops/supervisor_live.py','ops/supervisor_cloud_source.py','ops/supervisor_audit.py','ops/telegram_gateway.py','ops/tests/test_supervisor_passive_notifications.py','ops/tests/test_supervisor_cloud_source.py','ops/tests/test_telegram_gateway.py','ops/tests/test_portable_coordinator_retirement.py'):
 f=Path(path)
 if not f.is_file():continue
 text=f.read_text()
 names=[]
 for line in text.splitlines():
  if line.lstrip().startswith(('from ','import ')) and any(x in line for x in ('ops.','coordinator','codex','telegram')):
   names.append(line.strip())
 print('PASSIVE_IMPORTS',path,' || '.join(names[:40]),flush=True)
for name in ('ops/COORDINATOR.md','ops/README.md','ops/CHATGPT-MCP-PRIVATE-SETUP.md','README.md'):
 f=Path(name)
 if f.is_file():
  print('DOC_REFS',name,len(re.findall('coordinator',f.read_text(),re.I)),flush=True)
print('DEPENDENCY_AUDIT_PASS',flush=True)
PY
